#tastefulsafar

Hello Friends,

Welcome to the Tasteful Safar: Journey with Taste and Trust.

Bhogal Chole Bhature Wala is a renowned eatery in New Delhi, celebrated for its delectable chole bhature—a classic North Indian dish that combines spicy chickpea curry (chole) with deep-fried leavened bread (bhature). Established in 1962, this establishment has been serving patrons for over six decades. 

Location and Timings:

Situated at 3/84, K G Marg, opposite Scindia House in the Janpath area of Connaught Place, Bhogal Chole Bhature Wala operates from 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM.  The nearest metro station is Rajiv Chowk, accessible via the Yellow and Blue Lines. 
https://g.co/kgs/o5JpYPo

Menu Highlights:

While their signature chole bhature is the main attraction, the eatery also offers other popular dishes such as chole chawal (chickpeas with rice), matar kulcha (spiced peas with leavened bread), and paratha (a type of flatbread).  The bhature are known for being fluffy with multiple layers, and the chole is uniquely prepared, often including kofta (fried dumplings) and masala aloo (spiced potatoes). 
Given its popularity, the eatery often experiences crowds, especially during peak hours. It's advisable to plan your visit accordingly to ensure a pleasant dining experience.

snippet.title: Jama Masjid Market, Matia Mahal, and Chitli Qabar are some of the hubs for Eid shopping and eating
snippet.description:
Matia Mahal and Jama Masjid Market During Ramadan

Matia Mahal and Jama Masjid Market in Old Delhi become vibrant and bustling hubs during Ramadan. As the holy month progresses, these areas come alive with festive energy, attracting thousands of visitors for shopping and dining.

Shopping Scene
Matia Mahal, a famous street near Jama Masjid, is known for its traditional markets filled with stalls selling clothes, bangles, attar (perfumes), skullcaps, prayer mats, and decorative lights. The market remains open late into the night as people shop for Eid celebrations.
    Food Delights
The area is equally famous for its mouth-watering iftar (evening meal to break the fast) and sehri (pre-dawn meal) options. Food stalls and restaurants offer kebabs, biryanis, nihari, sheermal, shahi tukda, and refreshing drinks like rooh afza. Karim’s, Al Jawahar, Aslam Chicken and other eateries serve traditional Mughlai delicacies that draw huge crowds.
 During Ramadan, the streets around Jama Masjid are illuminated with lights, and the air is filled with the aroma of sizzling kebabs and sweet treats. It becomes a must-visit place for both locals and tourists who wish to experience the festive spirit of the month.

खरीदारी का नज़ारा
मतिया महल, जो जामा मस्जिद के पास स्थित एक मशहूर बाज़ार है, पारंपरिक दुकानों और स्टॉल्स से भरा रहता है। यहाँ कपड़े, चूड़ियाँ, इत्र, टोपी, जानमाज़ (नमाज़ की चटाई) और सजावटी सामान ख़रीदने के लिए लोगों की भीड़ उमड़ पड़ती है। रमज़ान के दौरान यह बाज़ार देर रात तक खुला रहता है, जहाँ लोग ईद की ख़रीदारी में व्यस्त दिखते हैं।

खाने-पीने की लज़ीज़ चीज़ें
यह इलाक़ा अपने स्वादिष्ट इफ़्तार (रोज़ा खोलने का भोजन) और सहरी (सुबह का भोजन) के लिए भी काफ़ी मशहूर है। यहाँ की रेहड़ियों और रेस्तरां में कबाब, बिरयानी, निहारी, शीरमाल, शाही टुकड़ा और रूह अफ़ज़ा जैसे ठंडे पेय मिलते हैं। करीम्स, अल-जवाहिर, असलम चिकन और अन्य लोकप्रिय जगहें पारंपरिक मुग़लई व्यंजन परोसती हैं, जहाँ भारी भीड़ उमड़ती है।

snippet.title: Best 5 Food Places in Pahar Ganj
snippet.description:
5 Places to Eat in Paharganj

Pahar Ganj ke Naam mein PAHAR hai, Par yahaan asliyat mein koi PAHAR nahi hai 🙂

So for today, I cover 5 Places you should visit in Pahar Ganj for its Food. Kuch aapke suggestions ho to comment mein likh dijiye jee 🙂

Janta Sweets

Normal jagah hai par aapko milenge aise samose jiske andar maa ki dhuli daal ki stuffing hai.  Uske saath  Subzi, Seasonal mooli ke lacche, aur ghiye ka achaar.

8102, Gali No.8, Multani Dhanda, Paharganj, New Delhi, Delhi 110055

Chawla ke Chur Chur Naan
Aapne Butter Naan Khaynege honge, Stuffed Naan khaye honge, par Chawla ke Chur Chur Naan agar nahi khaaye then kisi din Khane chahiye jee. Take any 2 Types ki Gravy (Karri, Dal Makhni, Shahi Paneer, Chole etc.) with Raita, Salad & these Chur Chur naans will make you Khush.

8955, Multani Dhanda,
Open from 12 pm – 4 pm & 7 pm – 11 pm
098719 81988

Radhe Shyam Subhash Kumar Bhature Chole
Amongst Delhi’s Top 3 Chole Bhature, Radhey Shyam serves Chole Bhature from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily. Bas humesha Bheerr lagi rehti hai.
Kha bhi lo & pack bhi karva sakte ho. Bas ek Negative hai, thori smell rehti hai wahan.
7, Amrit Kaur Market, Opp Entry gate of New Delhi Railway Station, Pahar Ganj Side
098111 03164

Banke Bihari Samose Gulab Jamun
They are mashoor for their Kachori Subji, Samose Subji and the World Famous Gulab Jamun. Kaafi Purana Naam hai inka and jab bhi jaao bheerr lagi rehti hai.
Aisi jagah hai ki aap 200 Smaose ya Gulab jamun maangoge to woh bhi ready milenge.

3179, Mushtaq Rai Khanna Marg,Ratan Lal Market, Chuna Mandi,
095998 19596

Shankar Chai Wala

Ekdum kadak, masaale waali badiya si chai, badiya se style ke saath milti hai yahaan pe. Aao toh try zaroor karna.

Gali No.5, Multani Dhanda

snippet.title: BEST Pocket Friendly Breakfast Spots in Connaught Place
snippet.description:
Most Asked Question

Tikku jee, Connaught Place mein kya khaaye, Accha bhi, pocket Friendly bhi

So jee, we have made many reels on this par. Long, detailed video ki demands thi, so here it is.

Now, if you're wondering WHY CP, then the answer is bahut offices hai yahaan and Rajiv Chowk is a Junction of Many metro Lines and because it is the centre of the city hai so, people find CP to be the best meeting point 🙂

These places are Pocket-friendly. Do not expect Gourmet Food here, but it Does the Job Well. 

Aapne Reel to dekh li hogi, let me also share the names and addresses again for more straightforward Navigation.


Poha Corner—This is a Small street-side shop open from 9 to 2 (until Stocks Last). It Sells Poha, Corn Chaat, and Namkeen Daliya at Pocket-friendly Prices. It's a regular place for people working around for a quick, healthy breakfast.
Behind Mc.Donalds, ECE House. Connaught Place



Baba ka Dhaba -  is a 40-year-old Shop where many Ministers and Celebrities have eaten. It is a Frequent Breakfast, Lunch, and Mid-Meal spot for people working in the Ministry or the Government office nearby and for Tourists and Food Lovers like me. Do try their Thalis, Samosa Chole, and gulab jamun.

10 am to 9 pm
Stall No 2 &3, Jantar Mantar Road, Janpath, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001

Kutty’s
Just next to Baba Ka Dhaba, This Shop dishes out Dosas every minute it's Open. Dosa ki variety bhi hai, Vada bhi Milega, idli bhi 🙂

Janpath, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi
9:30 am to 9:pm (Sunday Closes at 6 pm)
 098738 69738



Dhaba Food

Again, a 40-year-old shop. Dhaba Food Serves, Chole Bhature, Rajma Chawal, Kadhi Chawal etc.

Dikhne mein acche, Khaane mein acche 🙂

Shop No. 129, Municipal Market, Super Bazar Compound,
Near Shankar Market, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi 110001
Hours: 9am to  6 pm
Phone: 099715 59206



Odeon Sweets

Yeh dukaan bhi mein bachpan se ja rha hu. Inke Gulab jamun bhi acche, Inke Gol gappe bhi, Inke Chloe Bhature bhi acche aur inki Mithaiyan bhi 🙂

22, Shaheed Bhagat Singh Marg, 
Gole Market, New Delhi,110001
8:30 am to 9:30 pm
Phone: 092106 40716
